description: Sealed IP66 mast-mounted electronics body: 3-axis machined 6061-T6 tub with a bolted gasketed lid on the underside, an integral finned cold plate on the roof, a MIL-style circular connector plinth and a rectangular connector land under a drip hood, and a stepped rear mounting flange.
finish: hard anodise to MIL-A-8625 Type III class 2, matte black

orientation.note: Model frame = installed frame. +Z is up, +Y is outboard (away from the mast), -Z is the seal/lid face, the mast bracket bolts to the -Y flange.
orientation.datum_a: -Z seal face (z = 0) - the lid gasket land and the machining datum

dimensions.envelope_note: The envelope is 200 x 150 x 90; the part is designed 2.0 / 1.4 / 2.0 mm inside it so a tolerance stack cannot push it out.

lid_seal.description: Continuous face-seal O-ring in the -Z land, outboard of the cavity mouth and inboard of the lid screws. Both groove rims carry a 0.4 mm lead-in so the cord is not shaved on assembly; oring_groove() does not build that, so it is cut separately.

lid_fasteners.description: Blind tapped lid screws, perimeter rhythm solved by lib.features.bolt_pattern.

cold_plate.description: Roof of the cavity: the dissipating modules bolt up to it and the fin bank stands on its far side. Thickness is body_height - cavity_depth.

fin_bank.description: Vertical plate fins on the +Z roof; pitch chosen for natural convection, not for looks.

side_panel.description: Layered flank: a shallow recessed panel with a proud perimeter frame, and inside it a deeper lightening pocket taking the 24 mm seal-band wall down to 9.5 mm, with four vertical ribs carrying the handling load that wall no longer can. Both mouths are broken.

circular_connector.description: MIL-style circular shell on a concentric step-ring plinth - never butted onto the wall.

rect_connector.description: Rectangular multipin on its own raised, chamfered land with a 4-screw pattern.

vent.description: Pressure-equalisation vent at the lowest point of the outboard wall, on a faceted machined collar - never a bore punched straight through the wall.
vent.thread: M12 x 1.5 - tapped at manufacture, thread not modelled

drip_hood.description: Overhang with a shed angle and an underside kerf so runoff lets go above the connectors. The kerf is cut as its own operation: drip_edge()'s built-in rim chamfer is silently skipped whenever kerf > 0.

base_flange.description: Stepped rectangular mast flange built as two chamfered levels: a relieved lower plate and a proud mating pad whose centre is relieved 1 mm so only the band carrying the bolt pattern has to be machined flat. base_flange(edge='step') leaves every rim of both levels knife-sharp, so the levels are built separately.

emblem.description: The single identity mark on the part: engraved concentric rings, centred on the outboard face.

notes: Every radius, chamfer, wall, fastener pitch and edge inset in model.py is taken from lib.features.STYLE or from this file; nothing dimensional is written inline.
The lid, the mast bracket and the connectors are separate parts and are not modelled here.
Vertical-wall interior features are deliberately absent: a top-opening 3-axis pocket cannot machine them.
